data.description:
## Incident Overview

llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh exit-3 (OVER_BOUND) path does not write a stub findings.json, unlike exit-0 (all provenanced). The ci.yml liveness assertion at lines 720-737 then fails.

**Fix**: Write stub findings.json on OVER_BOUND path like exit-0 does.
**Probe**: Create commit with DSO-Over-Bound trailer, push PR, observe liveness failure.
data.title: ci-llm-review: OVER_BOUND skip path missing findings.json stub -> liveness assertion fails
